# GameAccountValue — AI-Powered Game Account Valuation Service

> A Telegram bot that analyzes game account screenshots using multimodal AI and generates verifiable PDF valuation certificates. Not a marketplace — it does not buy, sell, or broker accounts.

## What It Does

GameAccountValue accepts screenshots of game accounts, analyzes them with Google Gemini AI vision, and returns:

- A market value estimate (USD range, shown alongside the user's local currency)
- A value tier badge (9-tier ladder: Wood / Iron / Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum / Emerald / Diamond / Whale, based on the dollar estimate) and an internal quality tier (Starter / Casual / Pro / Collector, based on item rarity)
- Liquidity rating (how fast the account could realistically sell)
- A procedurally generated PDF certificate with QR verification code, a sequential collector's certificate number, and clickable links to both the bot and the website
- A public Telegraph landing page for sharing

Two tiers: a free 1-screenshot rough estimate (once per day), and a paid 2-3 screenshot full audit with the PDF certificate, priced in Telegram Stars.

## Pricing Tiers

- Free: 1-screenshot rough estimate, once per day, no payment
- Full audit: 2-3 screenshots, PDF certificate with QR verification, one-time payment in Telegram Stars, price adjusted by region
- Unlimited subscription: 7-day or 30-day pass for unlimited full audits, subject to a daily fair-use cap (higher cap on the 30-day tier)
- Referral program: anyone can share a personal /ref link and earn a percentage of a referred friend's first payment, credited as free-audit balance; a separate paid partner tier (limited slots) earns a higher percentage on an ongoing basis

## Supported Games

- Roblox — Robux balance, rare limited items (Korblox, Headless Horseman, Dominus tiers, Violet Valkyrie), premium/voice status, game passes
- Brawl Stars — trophies, brawler count, hypercharges, gyper/legendary/mythic skins, Sirius/Star Shelly
- Clash of Clans — Town Hall level, hero levels, epic equipment, scenery, CWL medals
- Clash Royale — King Tower level, card evolutions, champion cards, tower skins, CRL badge
- Free Fire — diamond count, evo weapon upgrades (Sakura, Hip Hop), rare bundles, OG UID
- Genshin Impact — Adventure Rank, 5-star character/weapon count, C6 constellations, signature weapons
- Mobile Legends — rank, collector/legend skins, hero count, Starlight membership
- Fortnite — locker skin count, OG skins (Renegade Raider, Black Knight, Skull Trooper, Galaxy), V-Bucks
- Minecraft — account type (Java/Bedrock), OG username, capes, Realms status

## Languages Supported

English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, Arabic, Indonesian, French, German, Italian, Hindi, Vietnamese, Thai, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Chinese, Filipino, Swahili, Malay, Uzbek, Kazakh, Turkmen, Kyrgyz (24 total) — with regional pricing tiers (lower Stars price in lower-purchasing-power regions).

## How to Use

1. Open Telegram and search @GameAccountValue_Bot
2. Send /start and accept the 18+ terms of service
3. Select a game from the menu
4. Choose free preview (1 screenshot) or full paid audit (2-3 screenshots, Telegram Stars)
5. Send the requested screenshots as prompted
6. Receive the valuation result, or the PDF certificate for paid audits

## Technical Architecture

- Platform: Telegram Bot API via python-telegram-bot v22
- AI: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal vision model, structured JSON output (per-game schema)
- Payments: Telegram Stars (XTR) native payment — no external processor
- Database: SQLite with WAL mode; all user IDs SHA-256 hashed before storage, never stored in plain form
- Output: Procedural PDF with radar chart and QR verification code
- Also available as a Telegram Mini App (free-preview flow) reusing the same backend

## Compliance

- GDPR: no raw personal data stored; /delete command erases all records instantly, including partner/referral data
- AI-generated PDF certificates include disclosure metadata (Producer, AIGenerated flag)
- 18+ only; terms of service acceptance required before first interaction
- Telegram ToS: compliant native Stars payment flow, /paysupport command available
- Not a marketplace: does not sell, buy, or broker game accounts; trading accounts may violate the underlying game's own Terms of Service

## Certificate Verification

Each certificate has a unique Audit ID (format GW-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX).
Verify any certificate at: https://t.me/GameAccountValue_Bot?start=verify_AUDITID

## Research Content (Website)

Beyond the bot, the website publishes original market research — real marketplace price data cross-checked across multiple platforms and regions, not estimates. Fully built out (9 dedicated per-game pages + 4 resource pages each, plus a free client-side value-estimate calculator with joystick/D-pad controls on every game page) in 17 languages: English, Russian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Indonesian, Arabic, German, Turkish, Vietnamese, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Polish, and Thai. Where a genuine local marketplace source was verified first-hand, it's cited alongside the global sources on that language's pages: GameTrade.jp for Japanese, ItemBay.com for Korean, UU898.com for Chinese (Genshin Impact only), and Allegro Lokalnie for Polish (Roblox only). No regional source is claimed for a language unless it was directly confirmed by viewing live listings — where none could be confirmed, the page states that and cites the same global sources as the English original instead of fabricating a local one. The remaining 7 languages (Filipino, Swahili, Malay, Uzbek, Kazakh, Turkmen, Kyrgyz) currently have a single combined market-report page with the same fact-checked pricing data.

- Dedicated per-game pages (price ranges, real confirmed value drivers, scam risks, and a free interactive calculator) for: Roblox, Brawl Stars, Clash of Clans, Clash Royale, Free Fire, Genshin Impact, Mobile Legends, Fortnite, Minecraft — e.g. https://game-account-value.com/roblox.html
- Combined hub page linking all 9 — https://game-account-value.com/market-report.html
- Glossary of account-trading terms (OG, smurf, reroll, Full Max/Rushed, escrow, chargeback, and 15+ more) — https://game-account-value.com/glossary.html
- Account trading scams & safety guide (real scam patterns per game) — https://game-account-value.com/account-trading-safety.html
- Cross-game price comparison ("which game has the most valuable accounts") — https://game-account-value.com/which-game-accounts-are-most-valuable.html
- Research methodology (sources, verification standard, corrections log) — https://game-account-value.com/methodology.html

Localized versions of the same pages are at the equivalent language-code path for each of the other 16 full-depth languages — /ru/, /es/, /fr/, /pt/, /id/, /ar/, /de/, /tr/, /vi/, /hi/, /it/, /ja/, /ko/, /zh/, /pl/, /th/ (e.g. /ru/roblox.html, /ja/roblox.html, /zh/roblox.html).

Every price claim traces to a specific marketplace listing checked on a specific date, cited on the relevant page. Where no reliable repeated evidence was found for a claim (e.g. no confirmed named-skin value driver in some games), the page states that explicitly rather than guessing. The on-page calculator interpolates only between these same cited bracket values — it never introduces a number not already stated in the surrounding text.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is GameAccountValue affiliated with game developers?
A: No. GameAccountValue is an independent third-party tool. It has no affiliation with Roblox Corporation, Supercell, Garena, miHoYo, Epic Games, Mojang, or any game developer.

Q: Are valuations guaranteed prices?
A: No. All values are AI estimates for informational reference only. They are not financial advice and do not guarantee any resale price. GameAccountValue does not sell, buy, or broker accounts.

Q: What personal data is stored?
A: A SHA-256 hash of your Telegram user ID, your selected game, and the valuation result. Screenshots are processed in-memory and never written to disk.

Q: How are refunds handled?
A: If the AI cannot identify a valid game account in the provided screenshots, a full Telegram Stars refund is issued automatically (or, for the free tier, the daily quota is restored instead of being consumed).

Q: What commands are available?
A: /start (begin audit), /unlimited (subscription plans), /app (Mini App), /history (past audits), /top (global leaderboard), /partner (affiliate program), /ref (referral link), /donate, /status, /cancel, /delete (GDPR erasure), /paysupport, /feedback, /privacy, /help
